name: Temple Hill Rotundas — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Two prominent cream-and-gold circular colonnades under indigo star-pattern domes, broad front steps, blue/gold circular courtyard inlays and cypress perimeter. Isometric suggests another rear rotunda not equally clear in front/mini-plan. Hidden layout inference: Use the visible pair as forecourt anchors, joined by a paved central spine and smaller garden landings. Keep column bays open where source shows depth, with a central framed focal recess rather than infilling every bay. A rear third pavilion is a labelled inferred option pending source parity. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B07-STRUCT-001 — Temple Hill Rotundas — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need circular column/plinth/ring-beam hosts, dome-to-drum seat and radial stair/courtyard joins. Existing source already supplies dome stars, acanthus capitals, urns and mosaic patterns; do not substitute Gothic palace capitals. Cypress/cream flowerbeds; restrained birds/pollinators. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
